protocol_revision_disclosure.v1_failure: all-tail linear/quadratic event score could not satisfy calibration safe false-positive cap and harmed nominal/smooth pilot
protocol_revision_disclosure.pilot_evidence_used: V1 family diagnostic isolated burst_outlier as the only tail-recall deficit; no formal artifact existed or was read
protocol_revision_disclosure.v2_change: event score target narrowed to the observed heavy-tail burst_outlier signature; HMM remains responsible for calibration-shift/telegraph and other event paths retain deterministic health/leakage evidence
protocol_revision_disclosure.v2_screening_boundary: posterior screening uses tail fallback recall >=0.90, tail false-update <=0.02, nominal fallback <=0.01 and smooth adaptive-open >=0.60; these are not paper safety gates and do not replace T6.7 preregistered logical-error/catastrophic margins
protocol_revision_disclosure.v2_full_selector_nogo: all 38 posterior-safe tuples failed the full preregistered pilot LER/safety selector when fallback switched to the initial static joint-MAP bank; closest minimum safety slack was -0.037109375
protocol_revision_disclosure.v3_change: tail/uncertain actions kept the last committed adaptive EWMA image active and froze future commits; the stateful candidate and policy-off traces were decoded independently on all 492 pilot trajectories
protocol_revision_disclosure.v3_causality_fix: the commit decision uses the last fully observed 32-decision posterior window; no partial future posterior window is read
protocol_revision_disclosure.v3_full_selector_nogo: all 38 posterior-safe tuples failed because freeze-all made EWMA stale during persistent calibration/telegraph transitions; closest minimum safety slack was -0.044921875
protocol_revision_disclosure.v4_change: maintain budgeted Window/EWMA shadow experts; promote Window only from causal latest-window prequential likelihood plus smooth/open posterior evidence, and promote the strongest pilot baseline EWMA for tail/uncertain paths
protocol_revision_disclosure.v4_prior_informed_hyperparameters: prequential score memory 0.0 and smooth posterior minimum 0.30 were frozen after a pilot-only sensitivity scan; 0.30 through 0.70 produced identical aggregate routing in the exploratory scan; formal remained absent
protocol_revision_disclosure.confirmatory_boundary: only the untouched formal_evaluation split can support T6.7 claims

model_selection.selection_truth_scope: calibration labels for model fit; pilot labels for joint proper-score/safety-temperature and threshold selection only; never online input

pilot_baseline_qualification.causal_order: predict complete period, then update next period from latest complete parameter window
pilot_baseline_qualification.fixed_precision: 10-bit syndrome ADC bin centres; same vector trace for every method
pilot_baseline_qualification.scoring_scope: registered scored windows only; nominal preamble excluded

selection_core.selection_order: lowest equal-family dynamic average LER, then global dynamic 512-window p95, global dynamic worst, update MAC, measured pilot wall-clock, canonical id

selection_constraints_in_order: all pilot abrupt/OOD catastrophic and nominal non-inferiority constraints pass
maximize aggregate paired LER-improvement 95% lower bound
minimize unnecessary fallback rate then total fallback rate

threshold_selection.selection_order: zero integrity failures; all pilot catastrophic/nominal gates; max minimum safety slack; max aggregate paired LER 95% LCB; min unnecessary fallback; min total fallback; canonical tuple
threshold_selection.baseline_note: selected once on pilot_validation under the T6.5.3 lexicographic rule; T6.7 formal reselection is prohibited and all baselines remain descriptively reported

lock_core.policy_update_rule: continuously update Window/EWMA shadows; at each 2000-decision boundary promote Window only after a causal pre-update likelihood win plus smooth/open posterior evidence, otherwise atomically promote validated EWMA

calibration/pilot-only HMM and common threshold lock
pilot-only adaptive-candidate method, observed-only dual-shadow bank arbitration and full LER/safety selector lock
not_admitted: formal smooth or abrupt/OOD LER advantage
strongest deployable baseline selection from formal results
integrated RTL equivalence, synthesis, measured FPGA latency or power
